cohort: 82 women (28 pregnant, 54 reproductive-aged non-pregnant) hospitalized with COVID-19
finding: No significant differences were found in the severity of COVID-19, virus clearance time, or length of hospital stay between pregnant and non-pregnant women.
mod_finding: Of the 22 pregnant women who delivered during the study period, no evidence of vertical transmission of COVID-19 was found in their newborns.
